title: Book Two · Chapter 91: Mum Chooses the Chair
story:
On Saturday, Mum collects a small chair from Mr Sun. It is the same chair she tried months ago. It is the right height for her work table. She saved the money for it herself.

Dad carries it home. Ronan opens the green gate and moves his shoes out of the way. The chair has a plain back and a wide seat.

“Is it new?” Ronan asks.

“New to me,” Mum says.

Dad checks the feet on the kitchen floor. The chair stands level. Mum sits on the chair and moves close to her table. Her feet rest flat on the floor.

Ronan watches her knees. “Better?”

“Much better.”

Dad puts the old chair at the side. It is still sound. Visitors can use it. But Mum does not want to work on it for hours.

“Did you make this one?” Ronan asks Dad.

“No. I checked it at Mr Sun's. Your mum chose it.”

Ronan touches the smooth back. He likes the idea of Dad making a chair just for Mum. But this chair is already here. She looks comfortable in it. She did not need to wait for a surprise.

Mum asks for a folded cloth from her basket. Ronan brings the blue one. She puts the cloth on the table. From the new chair, she can reach it easily. The table supports her elbows better.

“Can I try?” Ronan asks.

“For a moment.”

He sits down. His feet almost reach the floor. Mum's table looks very high from here. He stands up. Mum can have her chair back.

Dad brings tea. Mum keeps the chair near the window for the rest of the afternoon. She has work to finish, but first she drinks with both hands around her cup.

Later, a customer comes for a skirt. Mum stands to get the clean bag. The woman notices the chair. She asks about it. Mum tells her the price and the place. Dad stays in the kitchen with his own cup. Mum and her customer keep talking.

After supper, Ronan draws the chair in his book. He gives it four equal legs and a very wide seat. Mum looks at it.

“Room for two,” she says.

“Only if Dad keeps his knees outside.”

Dad looks up from his tea. “My knees have their own chair.”

Ronan adds two tiny chairs in front of the large one. Mum laughs. Then she asks him to put the drawing away. She needs her table. He moves his book. She slides her new chair into place.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

chair＝椅子；height＝高度；support＝支撑。

## 理解问题

1. Mum怎样试用自己的新工作椅？
2. 这把椅子为什么不是Dad的惊喜礼物？

## 读句子

**She / asks / about it.** 她／询问／有关它的事。
